questions.text: The ratio of red counters to blue counters is 3 : 4. There are 252 counters altogether. How many more blue counters than red counters are there?
A shop had 200 exercise books. It sold 30% of them in the morning and 20% of the remaining books in the afternoon. How many exercise books were left?
A water tank was full. 5/9 of the water was used on Monday and 1/9 of the water was used on Tuesday. If 243 litres were in the tank at first, how many litres were left?
The average of 5 numbers is 49. Four of the numbers are 41, 52, 59 and 44. What is the fifth number?
A train travels 180 km in 3 hours at a steady speed. How far will it travel in 5 hours at the same speed?
A rectangle is 24 cm long and 15 cm wide. A square has the same perimeter as the rectangle. What is the side length of the square?
A bag was sold for $68 after a 25% discount. What was the original price of the bag?
A number is multiplied by 5 and then 18 is added. The result is 118. What is the number?
There were 144 stickers shared between Ali and Ben. Ali had 48 stickers at first. Ben gave Ali 14 more stickers. How many stickers did Ben have left?
A baker bought 13 boxes of cupcakes. Each box had 8 cupcakes. He sold cupcakes in bags of 9. If he sold 7 bags, how many cupcakes were left?
